title: [Master] - Slice 640778: [Sustainability] Sustainability Entries should be more easy to find like other entries across BC
summary: Sustainability entries can now be found more easily through a Find Entries action on the Sustainability Ledger Entries page and new Sustainability Value Entries actions on Item Card and Item List pages.
key_points: Added Find Entries (Navigate) action with Ctrl+Alt+Q shortcut to Sustainability Ledger Entries page
Added Sustainability Value Entries action to Item Card's Related → History → Entries section
Added Sustainability Value Entries action to Item List page
New actions are only visible when Item Emissions is enabled in Sustainability Setup
Follows existing patterns used on Sustainability Value Entries page
quote: Find Entries on Sustainability Ledger Entries page
